about: Every Tauri command the frontend uses must either map to the agent tool(s) that give the assistant the same ability, or be excluded with the reason the assistant must not (or need not) have it. Checked by agent_coverage::tests (cargo test -p shodh-rag-app --lib). A new UI command without an entry here fails CI.

dynamicInvokeFiles.features/agent/useAgentSession.ts: Wraps invoke as call(command, args) to normalise agent errors; every command it sends is a string literal in the same file.
dynamicInvokeFiles.features/ask/viewer/sourceAccess.ts: Wraps invoke as call(command, filePath) to normalise file access errors; every command it sends is a string literal in the same file.
dynamicInvokeFiles.components/shell/ActivityTray.tsx: Picks pause_indexing or resume_indexing with a ternary of two string literals.

list_missed_reminders.excluded: Which reminders the user has not seen yet is notification state of this window, not user data; the agent sets and reads reminders through create_task, update_task and list_tasks.

dismiss_missed_reminders.excluded: Dismissing the missed-reminders notice is the user acknowledging it; an agent doing it would hide reminders the user never saw.

save_conversation.excluded: Persists the conversation the UI is showing, including the assistant's own answer as it streams; the assistant writes history only through organize_conversation.

delete_conversation.excluded: Deleting a conversation erases the visible record of what the assistant did and said; only the user may do it.

audit_verify.excluded: The tamper-evidence check is the user's control over the assistant; a result reported by the assistant itself is not evidence.

audit_export.excluded: Audit policy is withheld from the assistant: exporting moves the record of its own actions.

audit_set_retention_days.excluded: Audit policy is withheld from the assistant: shortening retention deletes the record of its own actions.

set_app_policy.excluded: Local-only mode and web access decide where the user's data may go; only the user may change them.

set_memory_preferences.excluded: Whether remembered facts about the user are shared with the model is the user's privacy decision.

memory_set_pinned.excluded: Pinning exempts a memory from fading; which memories last indefinitely is the user's decision, not the assistant's.

memory_export.excluded: Exporting writes every memory about the user to a file of the user's choosing; the assistant must not copy that record elsewhere.

memory_learn_status.excluded: Learning status, model and costs are the user's view of what the assistant learns; the assistant does not manage its own learning.

memory_suggestions_list.excluded: The suggestion inbox is where the user reviews what the assistant proposes to remember; the assistant must not curate its own review queue.

memory_suggestion_accept.excluded: The assistant must never approve its own memory suggestions.

memory_suggestions_accept_many.excluded: The assistant must never approve its own memory suggestions.

memory_suggestion_reject.excluded: Deciding on the assistant's memory suggestions is the user's review, not the assistant's.

memory_suggestion_undo.excluded: Undoing a learned memory is the user's correction of the assistant; the assistant must not undo or re-apply it.

memory_learning_stop.excluded: Stopping learning is the user's kill switch over the assistant.

memory_consolidate_now.excluded: Reviewing memories calls the learning model under the user's daily caps; only the user starts it on demand.

visuals_capture.excluded: Records the visuals of an answer as it finishes; the assistant's own answers are recorded this way, and an agent recording arbitrary blocks would put content in the gallery that no answer showed the user.

visuals_backfill_status.excluded: Whether the one-time import of older conversations ran is UI bookkeeping, not user data.

visuals_backfill.excluded: The one-time import of visuals from conversations saved before the gallery existed runs from the UI when the gallery first opens; it changes nothing the user made.

visuals_delete.excluded: Deleting a visual removes the user's record of what the assistant showed; only the user may do it (revise_visual adds versions and never removes any).

visuals_restore.excluded: Undo of the user's own delete in the gallery; deletion has no agent tool, so neither does its undo.

snippets_image.excluded: Returns the PNG the viewer displays; the assistant reads a snippet through its text with list_snippets and cannot use image bytes.

snippets_set_image.excluded: The viewer stores the image it rendered with pdf.js the first time an agent-made snippet is shown; the agent has no renderer, so create_snippet saves the region and its text and the image follows on display.

snippets_update.excluded: Titles, notes, tags and kinds of saved snippets are the user's own curation; the assistant sets them only when creating a snippet (create_snippet).

snippets_delete.excluded: Deleting a snippet is the user's decision, like deleting a gallery visual; the agent has no delete tool.

snippets_transcribe_latex.excluded: Sends the snippet's image to a vision model at the user's request (a second model call with the user's page image); the assistant reads the snippet's text, and LaTeX it already has is returned by list_snippets.

vision_capability.excluded: Tells the UI whether the Transcribe button can be enabled and why not; not user data.

results_extract.excluded: Extraction writes derived statements for a whole paper and may send its tables to the configured model; it runs when the user asks in the Results view. The assistant reads its outcome with query_results, whose notes name the papers not scanned yet.

results_review.excluded: Accepting or rejecting an extracted value is the user's verification of what the parser read; an agent doing it would defeat the review that keeps low-confidence values out of answers.

paper_graph_status.excluded: Reports when the citation graph was last built, its size and whether online lookups are allowed; the assistant reads the graph itself with paper_graph and is told when it was never built.

paper_graph_build.excluded: Building parses every indexed PDF and, when the user chooses and the privacy policy allows it, sends reference identifiers and titles to OpenAlex; it runs when the user asks in Library → Graph, so the agent never starts network lookups on its own.

get_background_status.excluded: Close-to-tray and start-with-Windows are user-only settings about the user's computer (AGENT_DENIED); the agent has no tool to read or change them.

set_close_to_tray.excluded: Whether Shodh keeps running after its window closes is the user's decision (AGENT_DENIED: close_to_tray).

set_start_with_windows.excluded: Adding a program to Windows startup changes the user's system; only the user may do it (AGENT_DENIED: start_with_windows).

switch_llm_mode.excluded: Switching the model or provider changes who receives the user's documents; user-only.

update_llm_config.excluded: Model and provider configuration changes who receives the user's documents; user-only.

test_llm_inference.excluded: Tests the user's provider configuration (and spends their credits); part of model setup, which is user-only.

browse_model_file.excluded: Opens a native file picker for choosing a local model; model setup is user-only.

set_custom_model_path.excluded: Chooses the local model file; model setup is user-only.

get_custom_model_path.excluded: Part of local model setup, which is user-only; get_settings reports the active model.

get_configured_providers.excluded: Reveals which API keys exist; secrets and their metadata are withheld from the assistant.

set_api_key.excluded: API keys are secrets; the assistant never sees, sets or deletes them.

delete_api_key.excluded: API keys are secrets; the assistant never sees, sets or deletes them.

agent_start.excluded: Starts the assistant's own session; the assistant cannot start, steer or stop runs.

agent_send.excluded: Sends the user's message to the assistant; the assistant cannot prompt itself.

agent_steer.excluded: Redirects the assistant's run; only the user steers it.

agent_abort.excluded: Interrupts the assistant's run; only the user stops it.

agent_approve.excluded: Approves the assistant's own actions; an assistant that could approve itself would make approvals meaningless.

agent_runtime_status.excluded: Reports whether the assistant's runtime is installed; it only matters before the assistant can run.

agent_install_runtime.excluded: Downloads and verifies the assistant's own runtime binary; installing code is user-only.

initialize_rag.excluded: App start-up of the search engine, run by the UI before anything else.

search_models_status.excluded: First-run check for the search models; setup is done by the user before the assistant can search.

install_search_models.excluded: First-run download of about 600 MB of search models; user-started setup.

answer_check_status.excluded: Reports whether the model that checks the assistant's answers is installed; the assistant does not manage its own checker.

install_answer_check_model.excluded: Downloads the model that checks the assistant's answers (about 96 MB); user-started, and the assistant must not control what checks it.

table_model_status.excluded: Reports whether the optional table structure model is installed (Settings); tables are refined with it automatically, so the assistant has nothing to act on.

install_table_model.excluded: Downloads the table structure model (about 212 MB); a user-started install of a local model, like the other model downloads.

set_answer_preferences.excluded: Whether flagged statements are re-checked guards the assistant's own answers; user-only, and the settings tools refuse auto_repair.

pause_indexing.excluded: Resource control for the user over background indexing; indexing the assistant starts is audited and runs in the background.

resume_indexing.excluded: Resource control for the user over background indexing; indexing the assistant starts is audited and runs in the background.

index_single_file.excluded: Indexes a file the user dropped or uploaded; the assistant indexes whole folders with add_folder and its downloads automatically.

check_path_type.excluded: Drag-and-drop helper deciding whether a dropped path is a file or folder; add_folder validates paths itself.

optimize_storage.excluded: Whole-index maintenance; bulk index operations are user-only.

cleanup_orphaned_documents.excluded: Bulk deletion across the whole index; the assistant removes single sources with remove_source, with approval.

clear_all_documents.excluded: Deletes every indexed document; bulk destructive operations are user-only.

reset_database.excluded: Deletes the whole index; bulk destructive operations are user-only.

upload_document_file.excluded: Ingests a file the user picked or dropped in the UI; the assistant has no file picker, and fetches files with download_file instead.

save_temp_file.excluded: Stores a file the user dropped into the window before indexing; part of the user's upload flow.

read_clipboard_image.excluded: Reads the user's clipboard on paste; the assistant has no clipboard access by design.

process_image_from_base64.excluded: OCR of an image the user pasted; part of the user's paste flow.

process_image_from_file.excluded: OCR of an image the user dropped; part of the user's upload flow.

get_search_history.excluded: Command-palette recall of the user's past queries; past conversations are covered by search_conversations.
